Game Overview

At its heart, Poppy Office Nightmare is a fighting game about survive the eerie halls of Poppy Playtime Co. in a thrilling 3D first-person horror experience. Explore and stealthily collect missing toys while avoiding the relentless Huggy Wuggy. Use your flashlight skillfully to escape detection in this chilling office nightmare where every shadow lurks with danger.
